title: ‘Gem Granites’ Veeramani case: Police officer M.A. Yasmin, who first handled the case, also transferred
summary: Ms. Yasmin, the ACP, Koyambedu, has been placed on ‘vacancy reserve’ on administrative grounds, according to sources. The police start probing charges that some political functionaries extorted money from the businessman

title: Activist sought further investigation in Ram Temple embezzlement case
summary: A former IPS officer and social activist wrote to the UP DGP, claiming that while the scope of the investigation continued to expand, the number of persons facing criminal charges ultimately remained limited to eight

title: Clothing tag helps Bengaluru police identify decomposed body of woman murdered about 20 days earlier
summary: The accused, identified as Sagar Chandra Rawat, allegedly killed his wife Anusuya Behara, 28, following a fight over a financial matter in their rented house near Sampigehalli on August 11

title: Ganesh immersion 2026 LIVE: Balapur Ganesh laddu fetches record ₹39 lakh at auction; traffic curbs across central Hyderabad till September 26
summary: No traffic other than vehicles carrying Ganesh idols will be permitted along the main procession route from 6 a.m. on September 25 until 10 a.m. on September 26

title: Western Ghats ESA: Keralam submits recommendations to Centre, seeks limiting area to 8,590 sq km
summary: Keralam govt to introduce resolution on ESA issue when State Assembly convenes next, says Environment Minister Sunny Joseph

title: Revisit SIR exercise, CEC must resign: Naveen Patnaik on report of internal disquiet in poll panel
summary: According to a newspaper report, Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had formally objected at least 14 times over the past 10 months to decisions and orders of the CEC Gyanesh Kumar.

title: Kerala LoP Pinarayi Vijayan seeks removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, halt to SIR
summary: In a post on ‘X’, Pinarayi says 'revelations' about objections raised by two Election Commissioners over decisions concerning voter registration, deletion of names and SIR raise 'grave questions' about functioning of Election Commission of India

title: Udhayanidhi flays TVK-led government over alleged sexual assault of schoolgirl near Vandalur
